The '''Cluster Navy''' was the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]'s [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|naval force]] operating in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It consisted of around one hundred small [[Starship/Legends|starships]], and fought the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at the [[Battle of Travnin|battle]] of [[Travnin/Legends|Travnin]].
